title: IndiaAI Mission approved outlay (₹10,371.92 crore over five years)
summary: In March 2024 the Union Cabinet approved the IndiaAI Mission with a budget outlay of ₹10,371.92 crore over five years, to be implemented by MeitY's IndiaAI division across seven pillars. Government communications also round the figure to ₹10,372 crore or 'over ₹10,300 crore'. Yearly allocations and spending have been lower than the envelope implies: PRS reports ₹2,000 crore budgeted for 2025-26 (cut to ₹800 crore at revised estimate) and ₹1,000 crore for 2026-27, with spending below half of allocations since launch.
purpose: Five-year envelope for the IndiaAI Mission's compute, datasets, applications, foundation models, skilling, startup and safe-AI pillars.
